title: Voltage divider schematic
prompt: Capture a schematic for a resistive voltage divider: a 1-pin input terminal VIN, two resistors in series, a 1-pin output terminal VOUT tapped between them, and a 1-pin ground terminal GND at the bottom of the chain. Every component pin must be connected to a net — no floating pins, no duplicate reference designators. The schematic must pass an electrical-rule check clean, and its netlist must realize exactly this circuit. Output a .vcad document with the schematic sheet (including its explicit netlist) in the document's schematic field.
